notes: Gold sold to consumers carries 13% VAT; since 1 Nov 2025 (to end-2027) jewellery makers withdrawing from the SGE deduct only 6%, pushing jewellery prices up, while bank investment bars keep favourable treatment. Brand jewellery is priced per gram above SGE spot with labour fee; no same-day local prices could be opened, so premiums and buyback are null.
